packageRules.description: Require manual review for major version bumps
Require manual merge for Longhorn: its upgrade stalls until every node is Ready, so merge only when kubectl get nodes is all Ready
Require manual merge for Gateway API CRDs: confirm the deployed Traefik supports the new bundle and that tcproutes still serves v1alpha2
Exclude date-based tags (2021.x.x etc) for LinuxServer images that use application semver
